'''Thanos''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Thanos system]] of the [[Taldot sector/Legends|Taldot sector]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], it contained an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Thanos shipyards|shipyard]] that was kept under tight control.<ref name="TEA" /> The shipyard produced exclusively [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Thanos had become an Imperial [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]]. After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the planet and its shipyard fell under control of [[High Admiral]] [[Treuten Teradoc]]'s [[Greater Maldrood]]. Thanos was eventually [[Battle of Thanos|captured]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" /> The planet would later on be invaded and occupied by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their invasion of the galaxy.
